 Sreemanti Sengupta Tue, November 10, 2026 at 5:42 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo by Dave Kotinsky/Getty Images for St. Ives Aspyn Ovard decided to explore other angles of love after her 2024 divorce. Consequently, what began as a casual arrangement with a couple has since blown up into a full-fledged throuple. The reality star opened up about her unconventional relationship on television.
 Aspyn Ovard explores love after divorce
 Aspyn Ovard's relationship with married couple Bri and Billy Davis will be featured in the upcoming Hulu spinoff " The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County ". In an exclusive preview shared with Page Six , the TV personality introduced viewers to her partners and talked about how the throuple developed. "Being in a throuple is something I never pictured myself doing before," Ovard admits in the clip.
 The YouTuber's personal life took a dramatic turn after her 2024 divorce from Parker Ferris. The former couple had been together for eight years and share three daughters. Ovard said that her divorce gave her the opportunity to embrace an alternate romantic arrangement and made her interested in dating women.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement She met Bri through Instagram a year and a half ago. Ovard said that their relationship began when Bri asked her to be "friends with benefits". "It was supposed to be casual, and then here we are; it is not casual," she says in the preview. Despite not wanting to date a man again, Ovard developed a connection with Bri's husband, Billy. The three began spending time together and clicked almost immediately.
 In a June YouTube Q&A, Ovard clarified how she views the relationship. Responding to comments describing her as someone dating a married couple, she said: "Technically, that's not wrong to say, but that is not what's in my brain. It's just like, these are my partners. None of us feel like we're dating."
 The relationship will now play out on screen when "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County" premieres on Hulu on November 12.
